name: Chilli pepper
grown_as: A tender annual grown in a greenhouse or on a sunny windowsill. William grows 'Serrano' (AG 40). ⚠️ CHECK
habit: A bushy, branching plant 40 to 90 cm with smooth green stems that fork repeatedly; a flower or fruit sits in each fork.

leaf.arrangement: Alternate, often appearing in pairs of unequal size near the forks
leaf.veins: Pinnate, a pale midrib and 4 to 6 curving pairs of side veins

flower.petals: Five or six, joined at the base, pointed and spreading
flower.colour: White to greenish-white (purple in some varieties)
flower.centre: Five or six separate stamens with blue-violet anthers
flower.behind: A small green cup-shaped calyx with tiny teeth, which stays as a cap on the fruit
flower.carried: Singly (sometimes two) on a slender stalk at each fork of the stem or leaf joint, hanging down

fruit: 'Serrano': small, slim, bullet-shaped fruit 4 to 8 cm with a blunt rounded tip, smooth and glossy, dark green ripening to red, hanging down from its stalk with a green cup at the top. Seeds flat, round to kidney-shaped, cream-yellow, 3 to 4 mm, clustered on a pale core inside. ⚠️ CHECK
seedling: Two long, narrow, strap-shaped seed leaves 2 to 3 cm, hairless; the first true leaves simple, oval and glossy.
winter: Nothing outdoors; plants can be kept indoors over winter

leaf: a simple oval to lance-shaped leaf with a long point
bloom: a small white five-pointed star, nodding
seed: a flat round to kidney-shaped seed
seedling: two long narrow strap-shaped seed leaves
a small oval glossy first leaf
young: a small bushy plant with forking stems
flower: one at each fork of the stem
crop: small slim bullet-shaped chillies with blunt tips, glossy dark green and red, hanging down
a green cup at the top of each

look_alikes: Sweet pepper is the same species with big blocky fruit. Aubergine has felted wavy leaves and violet flowers. Black nightshade (Solanum nigrum) has white flowers with a yellow cone and small black berries.
